context: A boss reviews a corporate risk
purpose: Teach: 薬剤/警報/逃亡/県庁/各省/一国/迫害/消毒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の薬剤管理、警報レベルで動いている。
lines.en: Pharmacy management across the industry is moving at critical alert levels.
lines.style: Clipped, measured authority. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with weight. No softening — the facts are the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の逃亡騒ぎ、メディア対応中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're managing media around the suspect's disappearance.
lines.style: Steady, respectful confirmation. Slight forward lean showing engagement. Calm efficiency — no panic in the tempo, just focused work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 県庁、各省と歩調を合わせろ。
lines.en: Coordinate with the prefectural office and all relevant ministries.
lines.style: Quiet command. Not raised — lowered, if anything. The firmness comes from certainty, not volume. Eyes hold for a moment longer than usual.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一国規模のリコール、初動を急ぎます。
lines.en: We'll accelerate the initial response on this nationwide recall.
lines.style: Affirmative nod built into the voice. Professional pace, no rushing or dragging. The words land cleanly — this is what happens next.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 関係者が迫害される構図、避けろ。消毒の周知も。
lines.en: Avoid any structure that scapegoats people involved. And make sure disinfection protocols get publicized.
lines.style: Two separate directives, equally weighted. First one slightly softer — moral clarity without preaching. Second one crisper — tactical. Closes with a full stop.
